## Bio


I am Ina Krapp, a Technical Employee working for the German Weather Service. My primary interest lies in the intersection of Geography and Informatics, and the contributions AI can bring to these fields.
By training I'm a geographer and quantitative economist, but I've learnt several programming languages along the way and program all the time.

On this site I keep a list of [my publications](papers), [presentations](presentations), 
and [my CV](CV_2026.pdf), as well as a [blog](blog).

<p></p>

## Selected Projects

#### R Packages

**[sfhoneycombs](https://github.com/InaKrapp/sfhoneycombs)** | Easily create honeycomb maps | 2026

**[sfcentralities](https://github.com/InaKrapp/sfcentralities)** | Simply and quickly calculate central points | 2026 

#### Python Projects

**[Wisp](https://github.com/InaKrapp/whisper-locally-running)** | A Graphical User Interface for the Speech-to-Text Whisper AI | 2024

**[Quiz](https://github.com/InaKrapp/Quiz)** | A Graphical User Interface for a quiz, with various features such as the possibility to depict images when questions are asked, a progress bar and an exam mode where the user is informed about passing/failing depending on the percentage of answers given correctly | 2025
